mcp.note: REAL, not a scaffold — this repo IS an MCP bridge: a Figma plugin (manifest.json, editorType figma/figjam) talking to a localhost MCP server over bridge-server.js. Outstanding for mcp-maintainer: (1) fuzex-figma-bridge still has no tools.json declaring its surface or `mutates` per tool — the plugin protocol in code.js handles start-server/stop-server/mcp-request/client-connect/client-disconnect/get-server-status/ping, which is transport, not a tool manifest; (2) mcp-server-config.json hardcodes an absolute Windows cwd (C:/Users/izzyw/source/FuzeX) so the config is not portable to any other machine or to CI. The second server, design-frames-service, DOES declare tools.json with `mutates` per tool (services/design-frames-service/mcp/tools.json) — added together with the service in the navigable-frames extraction; see services/design-frames-service/docs/EXTRACTION.md.

a2a.note: First A2A onboarding in this repo (no prior a2a block existed). Serving role scaffolded at agent-templates/roles/design-review/role.json, backed by a real service (services/design-frames-service), not a placeholder — but NOT yet validated against contracts/a2a/v1/card-projection.md (that frozen contract was outside this session's repo scope). a2a-maintainer CI (.github/workflows/a2a-maintain.yml) runs on the PR that introduces this and should reconcile/correct card projection before this is trusted as fully conformant. Platform-repo tenant registration (item 4 in a2a-maintainer's scope) is out of scope for FuzeX itself.

portal.reason: FuzeX is a Figma/FigJam plugin, not a web app. Its UI runs in Figma's plugin sandbox (manifest.json: editorType [figma, figjam], ui.html) and networkAccess is deliberately restricted to localhost — there is no served origin to iframe and no remoteEntry to federate. Registering it in the FuzeFront portal would add a side-menu entry that cannot mount anything. design-frames-service is a separate, network-reachable product surface consumed by FuzeFront over API/MCP/A2A (not iframed), so this does not change with its addition.
